thread:
paul-nguyen: Announcing Private Data Privacy Mode (pilot) for Private/VPC/on-prem installs. Adds console toggle + export minimization to help with GDPR/CCPA requirements. Pilot starts today for invited accounts.

lisa-martin: Nice! What does "minimization" mean here?

paul-nguyen: Two parts: 1) export bundles omit PII-equivalent fields by default (we provide a redaction option), 2) telemetry sampled/hashed for pilot tenants per their choice. We also add a data-locality flag so exported bundles are generated only within customer-defined regions.

security-bot: Note: Privacy Mode will default to "off" for current tenants. Enabling requires Admin consent and a one-click affirmation that the admin understands tradeoffs (some telemetry & perf metrics will be limited). No private keys are exported.

legal-ops: Legal request: update attestation wording to include a sentence about data minimization and telemetry limits for privacy mode before GA.

se-leads: CLI and runbook changes? We need example commands for air-gapped workflows.

paul-nguyen: CLI flags added in v0.13.0 for packaging and privacy:

```
rwctl export-audit --mode offline --privacy-mode minimal --redact pii --out /tmp/rw-privacy-1832100000.zip
```

And consent creation includes the locality region:

```
rwctl consent create --admin admin@org.com --region eu-central-1 --privacy true --out consent.pdf
```

deploy-bot: Rollout note: feature-flag private.privacy_mode.pilot enabled at 1832100060. Regions: eu-central-1 and us-west-2 first. Pilot only to invited accounts. GA opt-in date planned 1832704800 (7 days).

product-ops: We'll prepare a 1-pager explaining the telemetry tradeoffs and mapping to GDPR controls for sales/SEs. Also adding a short FAQ for compliance officers.

lisa-martin: For customers using HSMs, does this change anything?

security-bot: No change to HSM cryptography. We continue to include only HSM usage metadata; customers must enable their HSM audit logging for deeper evidence. Privacy Mode does not suppress required HSM logs if the customer has enabled them locally.

se-leads: Action: SEs - add invited pilot customers to tracker and schedule a 30-min walk-through by 1832120000. Provide sample consent PDFs and redaction examples.

legal-ops: Action: Legal to approve updated attestation language by 1832160000.

paul-nguyen: Thanks all. If SEs spot any edge cases (e.g., downstream integrations that rely on telemetry), flag them here. We'll keep the pilot small and iterate quickly. :rocket:
